  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 13, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A 1St Floor
On November 13, 2025 at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 23, 2025

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Dr. Symone Starr Parker on behalf of Crusade Christian Faith Center to host a Harvest
  Festival Event at 400 W Beach Ave; Private Public Property; on Saturday, November 15,
  2025, from 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1)
  day event at Roger's Park; Applicant to hire two (2) police officers for public safety and
  adequate professional - licensed security staff to assist IPD with any potential crowd control
  Applicant may use "off-duty" law enforcement that are parents at the school to supplement
  the security staffing only. It should be noted that this is the applicants first event at the
  location. Police deployment for next years festival will be re-evaluated provided there are
  NO incidents at this event. All security personnel shall wear reflective vests for risk
  management; None Code Enforcement conditions; None  conditions for Fire
  Approval;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407194)

Item #2:  Pastor David Jones on behalf of Christ-Centered Ministries to host a Together in Graitude
  Thanksgiving Celebration Event at 714 N. La Brea Ave – 742 N. La Brea Ave; Private
  Property; on Friday, November 21, 2025, from 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within a private parking lot; Applicant to
  have all activity on private property; NO use of public streets, sidewalks or alleys; Applicant
  shall hire a minimum of four (4) professional-licensed security guards wearing reflective
  vests for the safety of attendees; Applicant may utilize off-duty law enforcement that are
  members of the congregation in lieu of security staffing. Reflective vests are still required;
  IPD WC will be notified and extra patrol provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state
  and federal laws; None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire
  Approval;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407130)

  any information on any celebrity music artists that are expected to attend. IPD will need to

Item #4:  Nicole Lindsey on behalf of Education is Key to host a We Outside Community Field Day

  12:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event at
  Rogers Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park; Applicant to hire 2 police
  officers for public safety and two (2 TCO's for ingress-egress of park parking lots. Applicant
  to also hire a minimum of four (4) licensed-professional security guards to assist IPD with
  any potential crowd control; Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply

  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff

  New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #10:  Cathena Scott DBA Melvina’s Golden Touch to operate as a Hair / Nail Salon at 2900 W
  Manchester Blvd; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering
  & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited;
  Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not
  permitted on the premises;Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject
  to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #12:  Karla Hildago DBA Nexo Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 3553 W Imperial Hwy
  Ste # 105; This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition
  set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood
  Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR
  BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all
  State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25%
  of total retail floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21
  is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type of
  weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco
  use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable;NO
